_comment: Integrity lockfile for the self-hosted on-device NER PII model (S1.4 / WEBEXT-CSP / SCRUM-2503 / #1253). scripts/fetch-ner-model.ts downloads each file from the PINNED model+revision below, verifies its SHA-256 against this manifest, and exits non-zero on any mismatch/missing required file (fail-closed BUILD). Weights are git-ignored (public/models/), fetched at build time, served from Arkova's own origin under CSP 'self' at runtime. SCOPE: this lock + #1253 are the PRODUCER half (self-host loader + typed NERModelLoadError + build-time integrity pin); the end-to-end §1.6 fail-CLOSED RUNTIME guarantee (making enhancedPiiStripper.ts THROW on a model-load failure instead of degrading to regex) is delivered by the CONSUMER change in #1262 / WEBEXT-03 (Lane 2), with which #1253 MUST co-merge. `transformersJsVersion` MUST equal TRANSFORMERS_JS_VERSION in src/lib/nerPiiDetector.ts and the embedded version of public/vendor/transformers.web.min.js (the file set below is the exact set THAT version requests for q8) — enforced by scripts/vendor-transformers-version.test.ts. To bump the model: change `revision`, re-run `npx tsx scripts/fetch-ner-model.ts --force --update-lock`, review the new hashes, and re-soak (PII-detection behavior changes).
